comparator.name: Biology
comparator.sourceNotes: The current programme totals 180 EC. The first year is a broad 60-EC biology foundation. The selected Molecular Life Sciences major contributes a 60-EC second year. Year 3 contains a genuine 30-EC minor, three permitted 5-EC Molecular Life Sciences choices including the required option-group choice, and a 15-EC research project. The discontinued Integrative Biology major is not used.

comparatorRouteSelection.basis: The generic target names no major. Integrative Biology is explicitly discontinued for cohorts from 2025 onward. The four current majors are all specialist routes and none is clearly more general, so the first-listed current route, Molecular Life Sciences, is selected independently of UCR fit.
